items.title: Swiggy shareholders approve 49.5% foreign ownership cap, clearing path to IOCC status
items.note: AGM resolution passed with 99.99% backing, clearing Swiggy's transition to an Indian-owned-and-controlled company and opening the door to an inventory-led Instamart model.

items.title: Nikhil Kamath, Sreeram Reddy Vanga invest Rs 250 crore in CtrlS Datacenters
items.note: Zerodha co-founder Kamath and entrepreneur Vanga back the Hyderabad-based hyperscale data-centre operator's capacity expansion as AI and cloud demand grows.

items.title: NeoGeo raises $20 Mn Series A led by Neev II Fund and Aavishkaar Capital
items.note: Gurugram-based geospatial intelligence startup NeoGeoInfo Technologies will use the round for R&D, international expansion and product development.

items.title: Shiprocket shares make a solid debut, list at 35% premium over IPO price
items.note: The logistics aggregator's Rs 1,617-crore IPO, subscribed nearly 100 times, listed strongly on NSE and BSE, pushing market cap to about Rs 9,422 crore.

items.title: India's semiconductor ecosystem set for expansion, 5-6 projects may go live by 2026-end: MeitY Secy S Krishnan
items.note: MeitY Secretary S Krishnan said several approved fab and ATMP projects remain on track for commercial production by year-end.

items.title: Semicon India 2026 to showcase chip ecosystem, feature global CEOs
items.note: Preview of the fifth Semicon India conference, scheduled for September 17-19 in Delhi with PM Modi expected to inaugurate.

items.title: ISRO set to end seven-month launch freeze with GISAT-1A in September
items.note: The GSLV-launched earth-observation satellite will be ISRO's first mission since the PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 failure in January.

items.title: Jio Prime membership offers tariff price protection as it eyes Airtel subscribers
items.note: Analysts frame the new Rs 300 one-time Jio Prime membership as a response to Airtel's tariff rationalisation and a bid to retain subscribers ahead of expected hikes.

items.title: Ant Group sells 3% Paytm stake in $309 million deal
items.note: A block deal worth roughly Rs 2,949 crore saw Ant-linked Resilient Asset Management trim its holding in the Indian fintech.

items.title: Perplexity's free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
items.note: Perplexity's India mobile revenue and user base have grown sharply this year as it competes with OpenAI and Google for the market.

items.title: Your next Zomato order could cost 10-30% more as sustainable packaging shift looms
items.note: Zomato's chief sustainability officer says moving away from plastic packaging needs wider scale before costs can come down for consumers.
